player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped exploring after returning to the Living room, assuming all rooms were visited, but I never updated the graph with the edges I had just traversed (e.g., the connection between Pantry and Cellar, or Utility room and Laundry room). My strategy lacked a mechanism to track visited nodes and unvisited neighbors systematically. Next time, I will maintain a mental set of visited rooms and only declare "DONE" when the set of visited rooms equals the total count of unique rooms encountered. Crucially, I will ensure that every time I move, I explicitly add the new edge to the "edges" dictionary in the JSON response, updating the specific direction key (e.g., "north", "south") to include the tuple of the previous room and the current room, rather than leaving those lists empty. I will also verify that no new rooms remain reachable before sending "DONE".
